mechanism: Bumetanide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may increase mesalamine nephrotoxicity risk and reduce renal drug clearance; mesalamine may impair renal function, compounding loop diuretic effects.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; assess electrolytes periodically; consider alternative anti-inflammatory agents if renal function deteriorates.
